summary: Frontend E2E testing of iter277 (Fondo Empresa unified Depósitos+Retiros). Verified: unified section header, absence of 'Ajuste manual' and history buttons, presence of Depósito/Retiro/Caja fisica buttons. Deposit flow with Efectivo+CUP+bills works (adj-cash-account, adj-denom-*, 2FA, toast, row in table). Filter Tipo (Todos/Depósitos/Retiros) works. CashBox denominations dialog reflects 3x1000 CUP after deposit (main bug from user is FIXED — no longer 0). Add new CUP 20000 denomination works (toast + appears in grid). Account breakdown dialog shows Fondo Resilience 3,000 CUP, denom inputs precargados (1000×3), summary 'Cuadrada' with NO phantom diff (main bug FIXED). Transfer form opens with tr-from/tr-to/tr-amount/tr-submit. Backend smoke: denominations-config and cash-denominations both return 200 with expected shape. Retiro creation UI works after seeding CUP fund (needed because CUP balance was negative). CRITICAL BUG FOUND on 'Pagado' flow when only 1 cash account exists for currency: FundAccountSelect autoMode with options.length===1 shows label but does NOT call onChange, so paidFromAccount stays UNASSIGNED, payAccountMethod stays null, and PayCashBills (cw-pay-denominations-block) NEVER renders, so no bill breakdown captured; backend also won't receive paid_from_account_id → retiro paid without deducting bills from that account. Also observed dev-mode 'ResizeObserver loop' errors triggering CRA overlay that intercepts clicks (harmless benign, but degrades UX in dev preview).

ui_bugs.issue: When there is only 1 fund account for the currency (e.g. CUP has just 'Fondo Resilience'), the component renders the informative label with data-testid=<testid>-auto but never invokes onChange(options[0].id). This leaves paidFromAccount=UNASSIGNED in useCompanyFunds, so payAccountMethod stays null and the PayCashBills bill-breakdown block (data-testid=cw-pay-denominations-block) never appears in the TotpPromptDialog when marking a retiro as 'Pagado'. Consequence: bills are not deducted from the cash account, undermining the iter277 fix. Fix: add a useEffect in FundAccountSelect that calls onChange(options[0].id) once when autoMode && options.length===1 && value===UNASSIGNED.

Console warns: 'Encountered two children with the same key, TEST_X'. There are >=3 currencies with id 'TEST_X' in the currency select of Depósito dialog (seen: 'TEST_X · Test Currency' three times). Safe rendering key should include index or unique id.

Repeated 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' errors trigger the react-scripts error overlay which intercepts clicks and confuses users/automation. Recommend swallowing this benign error via a top-level handler in index.js.

critical_code_review_comments: FundAccountSelect.jsx autoMode branch (lines 55-65) omits the auto-selection side-effect; this is the direct cause of the iter277 pagado bill-breakdown regression when only one cash account exists.

useCompanyFunds.js relies on paidFromAccount being set for both body.paid_from_account_id and rendering the bill-breakdown; centralising the auto-select there (useEffect on payOptions length===1) would also protect any future component reuse.
AdminCompanyFunds.jsx renders currency options presumably by iterating raw list; duplicate ids ('TEST_X') should be filtered or the option key should include index.

rca of the issue: PRIMARY BUG: FundAccountSelect.jsx autoMode branch for options.length===1 renders the informative label but omits the side-effect of setting the parent value (no onChange call). useCompanyFunds.js reads payAccountMethod as payOptions.find(o=>o.id===paidFromAccount)?.method; because paidFromAccount stayed at initial UNASSIGNED, payAccountMethod remains null and the conditional {payAccountMethod === 'cash' && <PayCashBills.../>} in AdminCompanyFunds.jsx never renders. Fix: add useEffect(() => { if (autoMode && options?.length===1 && value===UNASSIGNED) onChange(options[0].id); }, [autoMode, options, value, onChange]) in FundAccountSelect.jsx (or equivalent effect inside useCompanyFunds on payOptions change).
